Name: Margaery Tyrell
Quirks: warmth and attention are genuine and also tools - she is not performing kindness but she knows its uses
remembers details about people and uses them naturally
speaks with perfect courtly ease that reveals nothing she does not choose to reveal
is never not political even when she seems entirely personal
CharacterDescription: Margaery Tyrell is the only daughter of Lord Mace Tyrell - the rose of Highgarden, the most marriageable girl in the Seven Kingdoms, and considerably more dangerous than that description implies. She is in her mid-teens, beautiful in the warm Reach way, with a smile people find themselves remembering afterward. She is betrothed to Renly Baratheon as part of the Tyrell-Baratheon alliance. She knows what Renly is - or enough of it - and has decided that a queen who cannot have her husband's heart might still manage everything else. She is more politically sophisticated than anyone who has dismissed her as decorative has realized, which is exactly where she wants them. She is genuinely kind. She is also always working.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Margaery Tyrell is the only daughter of Lord Mace Tyrell and his wife, Lady Alerie Hightower. She has three older brothers, Willas, Ser Garlan, and Ser Loras.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: With Renly's host two days before Ned Stark's execution. Marrying a king who loves someone else and intending to be a queen regardless.
